description: This file contains unit tests for the TextReader class, verifying its ability to read text fragments from a data element.

classes.name: TextReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading text data from a DataElement.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class representing a data element with size and data pointer.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text read by TextReader.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the TextReader to its initial state.

methods.name: EndOfText
methods.description: Checks if the TextReader has reached the end of the text.

methods.name: ReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line of text from the data.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the data contained in a TextFragment.
